title: The relay is not a service
snippet: circuitRelayServer() gives every peer dialability; it serves no application code of its own — notes 04 §6 and 07 §3.

title: Capabilities, not roles — café édition
snippet: A `.access` entry names what code checks, never who someone is. Renaming a role touches no policy file at all — safe even with an é in the title.

title: Search results live in the body 🔍
snippet: HTTP header values are latin1 by specification — 🔍 and é both fail before the request reaches the wire if you put them in a header instead.

title: Revocation is a role change to the empty set
snippet: No clock synchronisation: both iat and changedAt are minted by the hub, so the comparison is between two hub-issued timestamps.

title: Two ports, two origins, two ServiceWorker scopes
snippet: The static server binds two ports so the main app page and the image peer page never share a SwHttpAdapter key.
